meta.title: Verana certification
meta.description: Mobiera trains integrators to build on Verana and certifies the professionals who pass the eight exams. Verana Certified Professional and Verana Certified Integrator, for Latin America.

hero.title: Get Verana certified.
hero.lead: Mobiera trains integrators to build on Verana and certifies the professionals who pass the exams: business wallets, ecosystems, hosting services for customers, personal wallets, and how to sell and represent Verana. Designated by the Verana Foundation as an official certificator for Latin America.

why.lead: Verana is open, public infrastructure. What a customer buys from an integrator is the ability to put it to work: a business wallet that stays up, an ecosystem whose governance holds, services hosted with the keys and the operations a regulated client expects. Certification proves an integrator can do that, against a curriculum maintained by Mobiera as an official certificator designated by the Foundation for Latin America.

path.title: From Foundation member to a credential in your business wallet

tracks.title: Verana foundations
tracks.body: The three parts (trust ecosystems, verifiable identity, the Trust Graph), the public registry, the standards.

tracks.title: Business wallets
tracks.body: Deploying and operating VS-Agent: DIDs, credentials and Linked Verifiable Presentations, key custody, upgrades.

tracks.title: Ecosystems
tracks.body: Credential schemas, the participant tree, permission modes, business models, a governance framework from the Council's template, onboarding participants.

tracks.title: Hosting services for customers
tracks.body: Issuers, verifiers and AI agents as Verifiable Services; operations, monitoring, backups, security.

tracks.title: Personal wallets
tracks.body: Integrating and customizing wallets with Verana, DIDComm and OpenID4VC flows, interoperability on the Playground.

tracks.title: Selling Verana-based services
tracks.body: The value proposition, ecosystem business models, the pitch to a customer.

tracks.title: The Verana community
tracks.body: The Foundation's working groups, how to take part and how to promote them.

tracks.title: The Verana brand
tracks.body: Usage rules and recommendations: what an integrator may claim, and how to present it.

exams.lead: One exam per track, eight in total. Hands-on on the Verana testnet, in person, in English or Spanish. Online exams follow. Pass mark: 90 percent per exam. A failed exam is retaken on its own, with no waiting period. Pass every exam and you are a Verana Certified Professional.

training.lead: Instructor-led by Mobiera, about three weeks, scheduled per company. Self-paced material on docs.verana.io as it is published.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.body: A Contributor member of the Verana Foundation. Contributor membership is free and open to individuals.

companies.title: Companies
companies.body: A Contributor or Associate member of the Verana Foundation.

professional.title: Verana Certified Professional
professional.body: By exam, valid two years. Issued as a certificate and as a Verifiable Credential to the professional's personal wallet.

integrator.title: Verana Certified Integrator
integrator.body: A company with two certified professionals and one delivered project, or a public Playground use case published on its own infrastructure. Issued as a Verifiable Credential to the company's business wallet.

integrators.lead: A company proves its certification from its own business wallet, verifiable by anyone, the same way it will prove everything else on Verana. This list is generated from the Trust Graph, not maintained by hand.
integrators.emptyTitle: The first cohort is in training
integrators.emptyBody: Certified integrators appear here from the Trust Graph: the companies whose business wallet presents a valid Verana Certified Integrator credential issued by Mobiera.
integrators.emptyDirectoryOff: The directory switches on when the Trust Graph is live.

audience.lead: Integrators, software vendors, consultancies and operator IT teams in Latin America.

pricing.lead: On request. Training is scheduled per company.
